purpose: Repository-mediated execution control for O Chat-mode parallel workers. This file does not control or replace the authoritative O Work primary executor.

coordination.phase_1_rule: Until parity acceptance is durably evidenced, A/B/C may work only on parity canaries, parity mechanism verification, or integration-readiness for the parity mechanism. They must not take unrelated primary-objective leaves.

phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.acceptance: Workers can reconstruct latest O state, choose non-conflicting useful leaves, execute all Chat-capable work, persist evidence/continuation, and hand off only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer actions without duplicating primary execution.
phase.on_acceptance: Set phase.name=phase_2_acceleration and optimize expected time to the unchanged primary O objective. Do not rebuild a new control plane.

problem_solving_contract.source: J-derived mechanism only; J AGI objective explicitly excluded

forecast_nodes: root: prove real scheduled-Chat parity without changing primary Work authority
A: state reconstruction and PR327 integration-readiness canary
B: isolated GitHub write/branch/PR capability canary
C: independent acceptance-gap and existing-solution audit
primary-only: integrate PR327 after unchanged-head gates remain valid

existing_solution_audit.result: PR #327 is the existing structural solution candidate; do not decompose into a second control-plane implementation.
remaining_unverified: real scheduled Chat worker runtime evidence for A/B/C under repository control
primary-writer integration of PR327 into O main

phase_1_plan.direct_attempt: Use the existing PR327 mechanism plus three real scheduled Chat canaries. Do not create a second parity mechanism unless this direct attempt is falsified.

expected_completion.approach: one canary cycle plus primary integration handoff
expected_completion.overrun_trigger: If A/B/C do not each produce a valid receipt in their next scheduled invocation, or PR327 becomes non-mergeable/CI-invalid, generate alternative plan branches and reforecast rather than adding unconstrained children.

phase_1_plan.transversal_rule: If active unresolved nodes exceed 5, first test cross-cutting fixes such as one shared claim/receipt schema, one common Chat capability adapter, or one integration-readiness verifier that can eliminate multiple leaves; replace obsolete branches while preserving evidence.

A.instruction: Independently reconstruct latest O main and read authoritative WORK_EXECUTION_STATE read-only; inspect Issue #326, PR #327 current head, changed paths, mergeability and exact-head CI. Verify no collision with primary protected state or other Chat claims. Persist a source-qualified receipt proving what Chat could read/review and the exact primary-only handoff. Do not modify O.
acceptance: fresh O main SHA and primary generation/execution identity recorded read-only
PR327 exact current head and CI conclusions recorded
durable receipt written and exact-readback verified
no primary lease/fence/frozen request/protected state mutation
A.selection_rule: Do this canary before any unrelated work. If a required read surface is unavailable, record the exact missing capability and execute another parity-only read/review leaf.

B.allowed_o_mutation: Only create/use the reserved isolated branch from a fresh observed O main, write only the reserved canary path, exact-readback it, and open a non-merged PR. Never write main or protected primary paths.
B.instruction: Prove actual scheduled Chat GitHub write capability without touching primary state: after checking current O main/open PRs/claims and confirming the reserved branch/path are unoccupied, create the isolated branch, write one small JSON canary receipt at the reserved path describing observed main, worker identity, capability exercised and safety boundary, exact-readback it, and open a PR without merging. If the branch/path/PR already exists from this same task, verify/read back rather than duplicate. Persist a note receipt with branch/PR evidence.
acceptance: fresh O main observed before mutation
reserved scope confirmed unoccupied or safely resumed by same task
isolated branch created or safely resumed
exact remote readback of canary file
B.selection_rule: Do this mutation canary before unrelated work; fail closed if any scope/path collision appears.

C.instruction: Independently reconstruct latest O state and current parity evidence. Audit Issue #326 acceptance against PR327 and actual Chat capabilities; audit existing solutions before proposing any child. Identify remaining capability gaps, transversal fixes, and alternative plans only if the direct PR327+canary approach is falsified or overruns. Persist a criterion-by-criterion verdict and exact primary-only handoff. Do not modify O.
acceptance: existing-solution audit explicitly evaluates PR327 before decomposition
durable receipt written and exact-readback verified
C.selection_rule: Do this canary before unrelated work; public web research is optional only where it materially resolves a parity gap.

optimizer.phase_1_goal: Make the three Chat workers maximally useful within actual Chat capabilities while keeping primary Work execution unchanged.
optimizer.phase_2_goal: Minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective using only useful non-conflicting Chat-capable parallel work.
required_each_run: Read latest O state, open PRs/issues/checks/CI, active Chat claims/receipts, and this control file.
Inspect actual worker execution evidence rather than trusting prompts.
Update this file to reassign worker scopes or priorities when expected time-to-primary-objective improves.
Do not depend on prompt-only coordination for substantive worker execution changes.
Do not modify the primary O monitor/recovery task unless the user explicitly asks.
optimizer.current_decision: Keep Phase 1. Structural mechanism exists and exact-head CI is green, but A/B/C have no runtime receipts yet and PR327 is not integrated by the primary writer.
optimizer.platform_schedule_change_reason: A and B had no runtime receipts and their prior minute offsets would delay the first Phase-1 canary by most of an hour; move only A/B earlier in the same hourly cadence to shorten parity time. C already runs at minute 40.
